visible_observation: The 'Recommended Actions' panel is a large, semi-transparent dark overlay that sits directly on top of the 'Precipitation Intensity' bar chart, obscuring the data bars and the chart title. Additionally, the 'High-Risk Districts' list is positioned at the bottom left, overlapping the X-axis labels of the temperature trend graph.
critique: The layout relies on a 'stacking' approach that creates visual occlusion. By placing the text-heavy 'Recommended Actions' box over the 'Precipitation Intensity' chart, the design forces the reader to mentally reconstruct the hidden data, breaking the immediate comprehension of the rainfall narrative. The overlapping text at the bottom left further degrades legibility of the timeline.
revision: Move the 'Recommended Actions' panel to the bottom right corner (below the Sea Level Rise card) to clear the precipitation chart. Shift the 'High-Risk Districts' list to the bottom center or right to ensure the temperature graph's X-axis labels remain fully visible.
protected_strength: The high-contrast color coding of the temperature trend line (blue to red) effectively communicates the thermal shift, and the large, bold typography of the headline indicators (+1.4°C, +12%, +8cm) successfully prioritizes the key data points.
